interface.signature: def transform(A: str, B: str) -> int:

preconditions.description: Both A and B must be strings.
The lengths of A and B must be between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if sorted(A) != sorted(B) else (len(B) - max((len(B) - i) for i in range(len(B)) if A.endswith(B[i:]) and all(A.count(c) == B.count(c) for c in set(B))))
postconditions.description: If the character counts of A and B differ, return -1. Otherwise, return the minimum steps, which equals the length of B minus the length of the longest suffix of B that is a subsequence of A formed by characters appearing in A in the same relative order as in B (specifically, the longest suffix of B that appears as a subsequence in A such that the remaining prefix of B can be formed by moving characters from A to the front).
The return value must be at least -1.
